types.name: Dataset
types.description: A data artifact produced by exactly one workflow run. Linked to its producing workflow via a single-valued reference (a plain FK column).

fields.name: producedBy
fields.description: Resolved Workflow for `produced_by` (graph traversal; batched per request).

types.name: String
types.description: The `String` scalar type represents textual data, represented as UTF-8 character sequences. The String type is most often used by GraphQL to represent free-form human-readable text.

types.name: DatasetTypeEnum
types.description: Kind of data artifact.

types.name: AccessLevelEnum
types.description: Data governance tier controlling who may access a dataset.

types.name: Boolean
types.description: The `Boolean` scalar type represents `true` or `false`.

types.name: Float
types.description: The `Float` scalar type represents signed double-precision fractional values as specified by [IEEE 754](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/IEEE_floating_point).

types.name: JSON
types.description: The `JSON` scalar type represents JSON values as specified by [ECMA-404](https://ecma-international.org/wp-content/uploads/ECMA-404_2nd_edition_december_2017.pdf).

types.name: ID
types.description: The `ID` scalar type represents a unique identifier, often used to refetch an object or as key for a cache. The ID type appears in a JSON response as a String; however, it is not intended to be human-readable. When expected as an input type, any string (such as `"4"`) or integer (such as `4`) input value will be accepted as an ID.

types.name: Int
types.description: The `Int` scalar type represents non-fractional signed whole numeric values. Int can represent values between -(2^31) and 2^31 - 1.

types.name: DateTime
types.description: ISO-8601 datetime string (UTC).

types.name: Workflow
types.description: A computational or laboratory pipeline run that consumes one or more samples and produces a dataset. Consumes samples via a multivalued reference — stored in Mosaic's `relationships` table, forward-resolved only (no reverse "which workflows consumed this sample" query exists).

fields.name: inputSamples
fields.description: Resolved Sample for `input_samples` (graph traversal; batched per request).

types.name: WorkflowStatusEnum
types.description: Lifecycle status of a workflow run.

types.name: WorkflowTypeEnum
types.description: Category of computational pipeline.

types.name: Sample
types.description: A biological specimen collected from a single donor. Linked to its donor via a single-valued reference (a plain FK column, filterable in both directions by equality).

fields.name: donor
fields.description: Resolved Donor for `donor` (graph traversal; batched per request).

types.name: SampleTypeEnum
types.description: Kind of biological material a sample represents.

types.name: BrainRegionEnum
types.description: Anatomical brain region a tissue sample was collected from.

types.name: StorageConditionEnum
types.description: Physical storage condition of a sample.

types.name: Date
types.description: ISO-8601 date string.

types.name: Donor
types.description: An individual who contributed one or more biological samples.

types.name: CohortEnum
types.description: Study cohort a donor was enrolled under.

types.name: SexEnum
types.description: Donor's recorded sex.

types.name: DatasetPage
types.description: Offset-paginated Dataset result set (mirrors the SDK's PaginatedResult).

types.name: FilterInput
types.description: Field/value filter (SDK query filter). ``field`` is a LinkML slot name (snake_case, as listed by `hippoSchema`); the equivalent camelCase spelling exposed on the entity type is also accepted. An unrecognized name is an error, never an empty result (issue #149). ``op`` defaults to EQ (equality); IN treats ``value`` as a list and matches when the field is a member of it (issue #102).

types.name: FilterOp
types.description: Predicate applied to a filter's field/value (SDK filter op).

types.name: FilterMode
types.description: How multiple filters compose (SDK filter_mode).

types.name: DonorPage
types.description: Offset-paginated Donor result set (mirrors the SDK's PaginatedResult).

types.name: SamplePage
types.description: Offset-paginated Sample result set (mirrors the SDK's PaginatedResult).

types.name: WorkflowPage
types.description: Offset-paginated Workflow result set (mirrors the SDK's PaginatedResult).

types.name: ProvenanceEntry
types.description: One provenance log entry for an entity (append-only audit trail; see sec6/sec9 §9.6).

types.name: SupersessionInfo
types.description: Entity-level supersession state (mirrors REST GET /entities/{id}/superseded). `supersededBy` is the direct replacement (null when the entity is current); `chain` follows replacement links forward to the terminal replacement.

types.name: XrefMatch
types.description: Entity resolved from an external reference (system, value) pair via the hippo_external_xref reverse-lookup index (issue #48). Generic envelope shape — the matching entity type is only known at query time, so `data` carries the typed payload as JSON; use `entityType` with the per-type queries for typed traversal.

types.name: RelatedEntity
types.description: An entity that references the queried entity through a relationships-table-backed multivalued slot (ADR-0002) — the reverse of forward multivalued-reference resolution (issue #146). Generic envelope shape — the referencing entity's type is only known at query time, so `data` carries the typed payload as JSON; use `entityType` with the per-type queries for typed traversal.

types.name: MosaicEntityTypeInfo
types.description: One exposed entity type from the deployment's merged LinkML schema (mirrors REST GET /schemas). This is Mosaic's *domain* schema introspection — the LinkML type model the GraphQL surface itself is generated from.

types.name: MosaicSlotInfo
types.description: One slot of an entity type, as classified by the shared LinkML type model (mosaic.core.schema_typing).

types.name: MosaicReferenceInfo
types.description: One relationship of an entity type (mirrors REST GET /schemas/{type}/references).

types.name: DatasetCreateInput
types.description: Create payload for Dataset. Relationship fields take the target entity UUID.

types.name: DatasetUpdateInput
types.description: Update payload for Dataset. Relationship fields take the target entity UUID.

types.name: AvailabilityResult
types.description: Result of an availability transition. Mosaic never hard-deletes; lifecycle status drivers (active/archived/superseded/deleted/distributed/removed) are recorded in provenance (sec3, sec9 §9.5).

types.name: BulkAvailabilityResult
types.description: Summary of a bulk availability change (mirrors REST POST /entities/{type}/bulk-availability): per-record error isolation — failures never roll back sibling successes.

types.name: BulkAvailabilityFailure
types.description: One per-entity failure from a bulk availability change.

types.name: SupersedeResult
types.description: Result of a supersede operation.

types.name: DonorCreateInput
types.description: Create payload for Donor. Relationship fields take the target entity UUID.

types.name: DonorUpdateInput
types.description: Update payload for Donor. Relationship fields take the target entity UUID.

types.name: SampleCreateInput
types.description: Create payload for Sample. Relationship fields take the target entity UUID.

types.name: SampleUpdateInput
types.description: Update payload for Sample. Relationship fields take the target entity UUID.

types.name: WorkflowCreateInput
types.description: Create payload for Workflow. Relationship fields take the target entity UUID.

types.name: WorkflowUpdateInput
types.description: Update payload for Workflow. Relationship fields take the target entity UUID.

types.name: BatchWriteGraphQLResult
types.description: Result of an atomic multi-entity write (MosaicClient.batch_put). The set commits all-or-nothing; `entities`/`relationships` carry the written (or, on a dry run, planned) payloads as JSON.

types.name: BatchValidationGraphQLResult
types.description: Whole-set dry-run validation result (MosaicClient.validate_batch); aggregated per-entity, no writes.

types.name: BatchEntityValidation
types.description: Per-entity validation outcome within a batch.

types.name: ValidationFailureType
types.description: One tier-annotated validation failure (sec9 §9.9).

types.name: BatchEntityInput
types.description: One entity in a batch validate/write request.

types.name: BatchRelationshipInput
types.description: One intra-batch relationship edge, created after the entities within the same atomic transaction. Source/target may reference entities created earlier in the same batch.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: types
fields.description: A list of all types supported by this server.

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: The type that query operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name, description and optional `specifiedByURL`, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a scalar.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an object. `fields` and `interfaces` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. `fields`, `interfaces`, and `possibleTypes` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a union. `possibleTypes` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an enum. `enumValues` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: LIST
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. `ofType` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: NON_NULL
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a non-null. `ofType` is a valid field.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

fields.name: defaultValue
fields.description: A GraphQL-formatted string representing the default value for this input value.

types.name: __EnumValue
types.description: One possible value for a given Enum. Enum values are unique values, not a placeholder for a string or numeric value. However an Enum value is returned in a JSON response as a string.

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

types.name: __DirectiveLocation
types.description: A Directive can be adjacent to many parts of the GraphQL language, a __DirectiveLocation describes one such possible adjacencies.

enumValues.name: QUERY
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a query operation.

enumValues.name: MUTATION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a mutation operation.

enumValues.name: SUBSCRIPTION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a subscription operation.

enumValues.name: FIELD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment definition.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_SPREAD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment spread.

enumValues.name: INLINE_FRAGMENT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an inline fragment.

enumValues.name: VARIABLE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a variable definition.

enumValues.name: SCHEMA
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a schema definition.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a scalar definition.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an object type definition.

enumValues.name: FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field definition.

enumValues.name: ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an argument definition.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an interface definition.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a union definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM_VALUE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum value definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object type definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object field definition.
